transcript.text: I need to flag a capacity issue before we proceed. While tuning an unrelated queue dashboard this morning, I found that the reserved production capacity can support the webhook service only with a per-tenant limit of exactly 60 requests per minute and exactly 3 replay workers. The draft's 100 requests per minute and 8 replay workers would exceed the reservation. I haven't updated the policy ticket yet, but a capacity-review commitment is required before sign-off to document the adjusted rate limit and worker count against the reservation.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to raise a customer-contract issue before sign-off. I confirmed with account managers yesterday that exactly 2 named enterprise tenants have signed webhook terms requiring payload retention to be set at exactly 7 days, not the draft's 30 days. The same terms require advance notice to those 2 tenants before the service is enabled. Providing that notice immediately would satisfy the requirement for next Monday's enablement. I finished reconciling the account list after the policy draft was circulated and hadn't yet posted this in the launch channel.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Document the adjusted rate limit of 60 requests per minute and 3 replay workers against the reserved production capacity before sign-off.

commitments.target: 2 named enterprise tenants with webhook contract terms
commitments.detail: Provide advance notice to the 2 named enterprise tenants immediately, before service enablement next Monday, per their signed webhook terms.
